Dynamic Lead Goals
Weekly Lead Goal = Monthly Lead Goal ÷ 4.33 weeks  ·  Edit the blue lease goal inputs to see all columns update live  ·  Close Rate = last 4 weeks from View B cohort tracker
Property Monthly Lease Goal
✏️ editable		 4-Wk Close Rate Mo Leads Needed Weekly Goal This Week Leads Gap vs Wk Goal % of Wk Goal Tours Leases Status
📐 Formula: Monthly Lead Goal is editable  ·  Weekly Lead Goal = Monthly Lead Goal ÷ 4.33  ·  Lead Gap = Weekly Goal − Actual (negative = ahead)  ·  ✅ ≥ 100% of weekly goal   ⚠️ 80–99%   🔴 < 80%

Lease Goal Progress — All Properties

📐 Lease Goal Formula Reference
% to Goal = Signed Leases ÷ Monthly Lease Goal · Remaining = max(Goal − Signed, 0) · Expected by Now = Monthly Goal × % Month Elapsed · Pace vs Expected = Signed Leases − Expected by Now · Projected EOM = Signed Leases ÷ Days Elapsed × Days in Month. Current-month pacing uses the latest day actually included in the dashboard data.
